official_definition: Great Crush (When Attacks) For each LV this Spirit has, discard five cards from the opposing decktop. If any card with Burst effects is discarded by this effect, destroy an opposing Spirit.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Great Crush] or [Great Crush: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Great Crush]", "give [Great Crush]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mills cards from opposing decktop to Grave.
